title: Quality Control and Quality Assurance Awareness
objective: Understand why quality control, quality assurance and controlled requirements matter in boilermaking.

sections.heading: 1. Quality requirements
sections.body: Fabricated work must meet defined drawings, specifications, standards and acceptance requirements.

sections.heading: 2. Quality control
sections.body: Quality control checks whether work and materials meet the required criteria.

sections.heading: 3. Quality assurance
sections.body: Quality assurance uses planned systems and records to support consistent compliance with requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Traceability
sections.body: Clear identification and records help connect materials and work to the applicable requirements.
